title: Periapical Radiography AI Training Assistant
descriptionIntro: Welcome to the AI-Powered Periapical Radiography Training Platform. An intelligent system designed to support dental education and refine technical skills in
descriptionAnalytics: practice monitoring and statistical analytics tools
descriptionEnd: , helping review skill progress and radiograph quality.
modeClassicDesc: Identifies 11 technical errors, angulation guides & positioning corrections.
modePathologyDesc: Generates candidate localisation overlays for supported structures and suspected abnormalities on radiographs.
workflowStep1Desc: Select imaging technique (Paralleling / Bisecting), receptor type, and target tooth.
workflowStep2Desc: Upload a radiograph. Gemini reviews 11 supported technical error classes.
workflowStep3Desc: Review or modify errors, access corrective guidelines, and save logs.
pathologyWorkflowStep1Desc: Select imaging technique (Paralleling / Bisecting), receptor type, and target tooth.
pathologyWorkflowStep2Desc: Upload a radiograph. Gemini generates candidate regions for 8 supported finding and restorative classes.
pathologyWorkflowStep3Desc: Review or modify candidate findings, view educational reference guidance, and save logs.
disclaimerDesc: PeriApicaI is an experimental research prototype and has not been clinically validated. AI-generated technical assessments and suspected findings are intended for research, education, and decision support only.
disclaimerAdvice: Results are not a substitute for professional dental diagnosis, treatment planning, or clinical judgment. All AI output must be independently interpreted and verified by a qualified dental professional before any clinical decision.
